about.title: About Serene
about.description: At Serene, we believe that great food, fine wine, and tailored restaurant menus can create a perfect storm of authentic connection and community – join us for an evening you'll never forget.
about.subSlogan: Where every bite and sip is a catalyst for meaningful connections with friends who share your passions.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.description: We felt a void—a lack of opportunity to socialize and connect with others. Inspired by this need, we envisioned an app called Serene, designed to help people forge new friendships over shared meals and fine wine. By incorporating a personality test, Serene aims to match like-minded individuals, fostering genuine connections that inspire and uplift. The goal is to create a vibrant community where people can grow together, share experiences, and influence one another positively. Through Serene, we hope to transform dining into a meaningful social experience for everyone.

ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.description: At Serene, our mission is to build a vibrant community where like-minded individuals can connect over good food and fine wine. We believe that meaningful relationships are essential to a fulfilling life, yet often feel like a desert in today’s fast-paced world. Whether you’re seeking friendship, networking opportunities, or even romance, Serene provides the perfect setting to meet new people. By fostering genuine connections in a relaxed atmosphere, we aim to transform dining into a delightful experience that enriches lives. Join us in creating a space where friendships blossom and opportunities abound, making every meal a chance for connection.

partners.title: Our Network
partners.slogan: Coming together to get inspired, ignited, impressed, and influenced.

brief.title: Toast to New Friendships!
brief.paragraph1: Serene hosts refined dinners with a tasting menu, encouraging guests to forge new friendships through exquisite cuisine, fine wine, and engaging conversations.
brief.paragraph2: Serene collaborates with top restaurants to offer exclusive tasting menus tailored for our guests. Each dish is thoughtfully paired with handpicked wines, ensuring an unforgettable evening filled with exceptional flavors and delightful experiences.

partners.title: Our Partners
partners.paragraph: Serene ensures the finest experience by partnering directly with restaurants, bars, and wine distributors. We anticipate you meeting your new best friend in the most enjoyable and elegant setting.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.enquiry: Still hesitate to experience Serene Dinner? Or interested in forming business partnerships. Contact us! We will get back to you asap.

HowItWorks.Title2: How to join and get prepared for Serene Dinner?
HowItWorks.Subtitle: Join us for a stress-free evening where we handle all the details, so you can simply enjoy!
HowItWorks.Step 3 Title: Your Perfect Match is Being Crafted...
HowItWorks.Step 4 Title: Get Ready for a Night to Remember
HowItWorks.Step 1 Description: Take our quick and fun personality test to help us match you with new friends who share similar interests and values!
HowItWorks.Step 2 Description: We've got your dinner plans locked in! Look out for an email invite for restaurant info, special Serene set menu, time, and location. Make your payment to secure your spot.
HowItWorks.Step 3 Description: While we work behind the scenes to find your perfect match, get ready to meet new and interesting people!
HowItWorks.Step 4 Description: Your final instructions will be sent out within 24 hours before the dinner! Make sure to read carefully and come prepared for an unforgettable evening.
HowItWorks.Step 5 Description: We're so excited for you to meet your new friends! Our dinner events are designed to bring people together. Enjoy the mini games, ice-breakers, wines, and fine dining experience! Don't forget to capture the memories with our film camera!
HowItWorks.Step 6 Description: Your feedback is crucial in helping us create better experiences for you and your new friends. Take a minute to share your thoughts! Your input matters!
